description: This file contains the definition of the LayoutManager class in PHP, primarily responsible for managing form layouts, widget instantiation, and attribute handling within a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: LayoutManager
classes.description: A PHP class managing form layouts, widget creation, and attribute handling in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the layout with default context and database manager instance.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a specified attribute in the layout's definition array.

methods.name: setAttributePtr
methods.description: Sets a specified attribute by reference in the layout's definition array.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified attribute from the layout's definition array.

methods.name: getClassFromWidgetDef
methods.description: Returns a widget object based on widget definition, mapping to specific widget classes, including dynamic class loading.

methods.name: getFieldDef
methods.description: Fetches the field definition from the bean associated with the widget definition, utilizing caching.

methods.name: widgetDisplay
methods.description: Displays a widget based on its definition, with options for retrieving name or ID instead of rendering.

methods.name: widgetQuery
methods.description: Returns the query string or object for a widget, based on its definition.

methods.name: widgetDisplayInput
methods.description: Displays an input field widget based on its definition.
